title: On Carriedo Street, Henry Sy Chose a Shop Name He Could Repeat
conflicts: Start of the shoe business: Sy's own 2009 account gives Carriedo stores from 1946 (Plaza, Paris, Park Avenue) before Shoemart in October 1958; Bloomberg says the company started as a shoe store in 1948; AFP conflates GI boot sales with 1958. Followed Sy. Birthplace Xiamen vs Jinjiang, so only 'Fujian province'. Funding: Sy said capital was internally generated, while Chinabank's histories record a P1 million credit line in 1949; both given.
notes: The episode is the 1958 opening and naming of Shoemart, a name chosen so it could be reused for branches (Sy's own explanation, Inquirer 2009). Town & Country Philippines (2018) was read but dropped because it no longer loads; the NYT obituary loads for the verifier but could not be read, so it is not cited. Emerson quote trimmed to begin at 'Not so' to avoid an exclamation mark in the source line; the connection supplies the setup.
